function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file from the repository and return its contents, optionally only a range of lines.

path.description: Path of the file, relative to the repository root.

start_line.description: First line to return, counting from 1.

function.name: search
function.description: Search the repository for a regular expression and return the matching lines with their file and line number.

path.description: Directory or file to search in. Defaults to the whole repository.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact piece of text in a file with another. Fails if the old text is missing or appears more than once.

path.description: Path of the file to edit.

new_text.description: The text that takes its place.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command in the repository root and return its output and exit status.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop the command after this many seconds.
